description: Diffusion policy (LeRobot 0.6.1) on lerobot/pusht_keypoints with 30% injected faults (desync, glitch, idle; 62 of 206 episodes). One seed, 30k steps, batch as in experiments/kaggle, Kaggle T4, Oct 11-12 2026. Run used rdq 0.1-era checks (position-based lag).
reading: Success rates are at the floor (0-2%): 30k steps is far short of what Push-T diffusion policies are usually trained for, so success cannot separate the methods. Mean maximum coverage (avg_max_reward) orders them filtered 0.44 > raw 0.34 > random 0.26, but per-episode values (needed for an interval) were not saved in the notebook output and this is one seed.
